4452-4693-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
4452-4693-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat from step 3.

147-2292-3905.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2292-3905.description:
Cast Unbreakable Bond by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Unbreakable Bond.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Unbreakable Bond
Resolve the Unbreakable Bond copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

728-841-4544--106.easyPrerequisites:
You don't control a Ring-bearer.
You have a land card in hand.
728-841-4544--106.description:
Play a land card.
Dúnedain Rangers and the permanent with a Landfall ability trigger.
Resolve the permanent with a Landfall ability trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Dúnedain Rangers trigger, causing the Ring to tempt you, and causing the creature token to become your Ring-bearer.
Sméagol triggers.
Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token.
Resolve the Sméagol trigger, causing an opponent to reveal cards from the top of their library until they reveal a land card, then causing you to put the land onto the battlefield tapped under your control, and your opponent to put all other revealed cards into their graveyard.
Repeat from step 2.
728-841-4544--106.notes: This combo can be stopped if an opponent runs out of lands in their library, so it is recommended to alternate opponents in between cycles to maximize the amount of iterations.

2558-5330-7916.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, its living weapon ability granted to it by Ekthi triggers.
Holding priority, activate Atog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Sword of the Meek trigger, creating a 0/0 Phyrexian Germ creature token. It'll enter as a 1/1 due to Ekthi's static effect.
When the Phyrexian Germ enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Phyrexian Germ.
Repeat from step 2.

2021-2060-2445-3921.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

2724-6432-7843.description:
Activate Elrond by paying {5}{U}{U}, exiling and returning (at end step) Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Wormfang Manta entering does not cause its abillity to trigger due to Doorkeeper Thrull.
Repeat each turn.

1263-2438-4871-6255.notablePrerequisites:
You have attacked this turn.
You have max speed.
1263-2438-4871-6255.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Zahur trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2457-4289-4365-7730.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

1753-2034-5477-5660-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate the Plant by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the tapped Plant, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with "Sliver" chosen

3767-4452-4465-4893.description:
Activate Rukarumel by paying {1} due to Training Grounds and tapping it, creating a 1/1 Sliver creature token.
Activate the Sliver token using the ability granted to it by Basal Sliver by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Rukarumel using the ability granted to it by Scuttling Sliver by paying {2}, untapping Rukarumel.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

206-560-1563-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

3908-7009-7309.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
3908-7009-7309.description:
Activate Spark Double using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Don & Leo triggers, blinking Spark Double. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control except Donatello

3259-5295-7291.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control an artifact creature.
3259-5295-7291.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Donatello and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Donatello and Breath of Fury.
Resolve the Donatello trigger, creating a token copy of the artifact creature.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the artifact creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase

5864-6723-7110-7111.notablePrerequisites: You control four in any combination of Birds, Frogs, Otters and/or Rats that do not have summoning sickness.
5864-6723-7110-7111.description:
Activate at least four Birds, Frogs, Otters and/or Rats by tapping them, adding {2}{U}{U}.
Cast Get Out by paying {U}{U}, targeting Stormchaser's Talent. Stormchaser's Talent's first ability, Valley Floodcaller and each creature you control that has prowess trigger.
Resolve the Stormchaser Talent trigger, creating a 1/1 Otter creature token with prowess.
Resolve each prowess trigger, if applicable, giving those creatures +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Valley Floodcaller trigger, giving Birds, Frogs, Otters and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Resolve Get Out, returning Stormchaser's Talent from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate at least four Birds, Frogs, Otters and/or Rats by tapping them, adding {2}{U}{U}.
Cast Stormchaser's Talent by paying {U}. Valley Floodcaller and each creature you control that has prowess trigger.
Resolve each prowess trigger, if applicable, giving those creatures +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Valley Floodcaller trigger, giving Birds, Frogs, Otters and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Activate Stormchaser's Talent by paying {3}{U}, causing it to gain level 2. It then triggers, returning Get Out from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

864-1987-4276-6991.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
864-1987-4276-6991.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Donnie & April and Eternal Witness.
When Donnie & April and Eternal Witness enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
864-1987-4276-6991.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

856-1379-4659-6748-6757.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3490-3967-4871-6829.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing any other creature you control.
When the creature dies, Venom and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Venom trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

2011-4076-4094.easyPrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill Burakos.
2011-4076-4094.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Declare Burakos as an attacker, attacking an opponent unable to block and kill it.
Najeela and Burakos triggers.
Resolve the Najeela trigger, creating two 1/1 Warrior creature tokens that are tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Burakos trigger, creating eight Treasure tokens and causing the defending opponent to lose 4 life.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

2092-3719-4865-5326.notablePrerequisites: Vesuvan Shapeshifter and Agatha of the Vile Cauldron each have a power of at least 2.
2092-3719-4865-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Vesuvan Shapeshifter and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Vesuvan Shapeshifter from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Vesuvan Shapeshifter to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Vesuvan Shapeshifter enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Vesuvan Shapeshifter by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

2457-3129-4365-5794.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the four Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

509-1267-3933-4639.manaNeeded: {1}{U/P}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {4} each extra turn
509-1267-3933-4639.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
509-1267-3933-4639.description:
Activate Unctus by paying {U/P}, causing Medomai the Ageless to become an artifact until end of turn.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Activate Karn's Bastion's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, putting a time counter on Idris.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 6.

1308-1354-1835-4275.notablePrerequisites: Zaxara does not have summoning sickness.
1308-1354-1835-4275.description:
Activate Zaxara by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Cast Wurmcalling with buyback by paying {2}{G}{G}.
Zaxara triggers, creating two 0/0 Hydra creature tokens.
The Hydras enter the battlefield and die as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Faces of the Past trigger twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping all Hydras.
Activate Zaxara by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the second Faces of the Past trigger, untapping all Hydras.
Resolve Wurmcalling, creating a 0/0 Wurm creature token and returning Wurmcalling to your hand.
The Wurm enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
When the Wurm dies, Faces of the Past triggers, either tapping or untapping all Wurms.
Repeat.

2743-3131.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least four creatures.
No opponent controls four or more creatures.
2743-3131.description:
Cast Nanogene Conversion by paying {3}{U}, causing each creature to become a copy of Biovisionary until end of turn.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary you control triggers.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.

229-4316-5220.description:
Cast Endless One from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Endless One enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Endless One on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

1558-2397-2963-4231-4979.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Gilded Goose.
When Gilded Goose enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two Food, two Clue and two Treasure artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat.

974-1953-2011.notablePrerequisites: There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
974-1953-2011.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token, and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Brudiclad triggers, creating a 2/1 Phyrexian Myr artifact creature token, then causing all tokens you control to become copies of the Smaug token.
Put all but one Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Myr dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

2060-3129-4153.notablePrerequisites: A creature you control besides Crystalline Crawler has at least five +1/+1 counters on it.
2060-3129-4153.description:
Activate Resourceful Defense by paying {4}{W}, removing at least five +1/+1 counters from a creature you control and putting at least ten +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability five times by removing five +1/+1 counters, adding {4}{W}.
Activate Resourceful Defense by paying {4}{W}, removing five +1/+1 counters from Crystalline Crawler and putting ten +1/+1 counters on another creature you control.
Activate Resourceful Defense by paying {4}{W}, removing ten +1/+1 counters from that creature and putting twenty +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability ten times by removing ten +1/+1 counters, adding {8}{W}{W}.
Repeat from step 3 any number of times.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability any number of times.
2060-3129-4153.notes: Note that the starting mana can come from activating Crystalline Crawler's mana ability. Starting mana is reduced if the creature starts with more than five +1/+1 counters on it.

254-301-5256.notablePrerequisites: Putrid Goblin does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
254-301-5256.description:
Cast First Day of Class by paying {1}{R}, causing all creatures that enter the battlefield under your control this turn to get an additional +1/+1 counter put on it.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
Putrid Goblin's persist ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Putrid Goblin enters the battlefield, triggering First Day of Class, putting a +1/+1 counter on Putrid Goblin.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 2, causing target player to mill cards equal to Putrid Goblin's power.
Repeat from step 2.

2144-2292-4215-5311.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Riftsweeper.
Riftsweeper dies, triggering Verdant Succession and Myrkul.
Resolve the Myrkul trigger, causing you to exile Riftsweeper and create a token copy of Riftsweeper that is an enchantment and loses all other card types.
The Riftsweeper token enters the battlefield, shuffling the nontoken Riftsweeper into your library from exile.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger from step 2, searching your library for Riftsweeper and putting it onto the battlefield.
Riftsweeper enters the battlefield, shuffling any exiled card into its owner's library.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

1713-4447.notablePrerequisites:
Assault Suit attached to Lurebound Scarecrow.
A player controls no permanents of the color chosen with Lurebound Scarecrow.
1713-4447.description:
At the beginning of the upkeep of the player who controls no permanents of the chosen color, Assault Suit triggers, causing that player to gain control of Lurebound Scarecrow.
Lurebound Scarecrow triggers, causing them to sacrifice it.
However, Lurebound Scarecrow cannot be sacrificed due to Assault Suit.
Lurebound Scarecrow triggers again, creating a mandatory infinite loop that causes the game to end in a draw.

2400-4923-5261.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
2400-4923-5261.description:
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Cabal Ritual without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Cabal Ritual, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
Activate Onyx Talisman by paying {3}, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.
